format: UTF-8 JSONL, uncompressed small daily/funding/sample files

row_fields.identity_sha256: string: lowercase SHA256 of canonical manifest identity
row_fields.open_ms: integer: UTC bar opening timestamp in milliseconds
row_fields.received_ms: integer: local retrieval timestamp in milliseconds
row_fields.historical_available_ms: null: historical publication timestamp is unknown
row_fields.available_ms: integer: same local receipt timestamp as received_ms
row_fields.open: string: original positive finite decimal; native quote per underlying unit
row_fields.high: string: original positive finite decimal; native quote per underlying unit
row_fields.low: string: original positive finite decimal; native quote per underlying unit
row_fields.close: string: original positive finite decimal; native quote per underlying unit
row_fields.native_volume_fields: array of three decimal strings for trade [contracts, base, quote]; null for mark
row_fields.volume_units: string: contracts,base,quote for trade; null for mark
row_fields.raw_sha256: string: lowercase local SHA256 of the exact provider response body

identity: The instrument manifest records native metadata, ctVal, ctMult, units and metadata response SHA
price_rescaling: None; all OHLC prices are native USDT per underlying coin
ordering: Strictly ascending unique open_ms; complete UTC grid; no forward fill

funding_row_fields.fundingRate: string: raw predicted decimal, empty preserved
funding_row_fields.realizedRate: string: raw actual decimal, empty preserved
funding_row_fields.identity_sha256: string: canonical native metadata identity SHA256
